questions.question: Who launched the first edition of the nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' to promote AI-based innovation in the insurance sector?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**SBI Life Insurance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SBI Life Insurance launched the first edition of its nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' initiative.**
 
• **The initiative aims to encourage tech students to address challenges in the insurance sector using artificial intelligence.**
 
• **The event witnessed participation from over 7,500 students, with 50 teams shortlisted for the finale in Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **SBI Life Insurance__ launched the first-ever nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' to promote AI solutions in the insurance domain.**
 
• The competition drew over 7,500 student participants from across India.
 
• Top 50 teams were selected to showcase their ideas in the grand finale in Mumbai.
 
• Focus areas included improving customer experience, fraud detection, and accessibility of insurance products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• SBI Life Insurance__

 __
 
• Established in 2001 as a joint venture between State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif
 
• Headquartered in Mumbai
 
• Offers a range of life insurance and pension products
 
 
 
• Hack-AI-thon Objectives__
 __
 
• Leverage AI to enhance operational efficiency in insurance
 
• Encourage innovation among young tech talent
 
• Address sectoral challenges like fraud, accessibility, and personalization
 
 
 
• Grand Finale__
 
 
• To be held in Mumbai
 
• Top solutions will be evaluated by industry experts
 
• Winning teams may get opportunities for incubation or deployment

questions.question: Which of the following won the 2025 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**La Prensa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nicaragua’s La Prensa was awarded the 2025 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **La Prensa, a century-old newspaper, has faced censorship, asset confiscations, and arrests under the Ortega-Murillo regime.**
 
• **Despite this repression, La Prensa remains committed to fearless journalism, earning recognition for its resilience.**
 
• **The UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize honors La Prensa's dedication to press freedom.**
 
• La Prensa__
 __
 
• Founded - 1926
 
• Country - Nicaragua
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize__

 
 
• Established in 1997
 
• Named after Guillermo Cano, a Colombian journalist murdered for his work
 
• Awarded annually to individuals or organizations that have made significant contributions to press freedom

questions.question: Where is the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) project based, which is about to assemble the world’s most powerful magnet?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The ITER project, a global nuclear fusion initiative, is based in southern France.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **ITER is a much-delayed international project with over 30 countries, including the United States, China, Japan, Russia, and the European Union, working towards generating clean energy through nuclear fusion.**
 
• The project aims to use a powerful magnet system to create an "invisible cage" to confine super-hot plasma particles.
 
• It marks a significant milestone with the completion and testing of the central solenoid magnet by the United States.
 
• Although delayed, construction is proceeding at the fastest pace in ITER’s history, with the start-up phase scheduled for 2033.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Capital - Tokyo
 
• Prime Minister - Shigeru Ishiba
 
 
 
• Russia__

questions.question: Where was the world’s first energy transmission garden, Babuji Vanam, inaugurated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The world’s first energy transmission garden, Babuji Vanam, was inaugurated at Kanha Shanti Vanam in Hyderabad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The energy transmission garden, named Babuji Vanam, was inaugurated to honor Babuji Maharaj’s 125th birth anniversary.**
 
• The garden is designed to enhance spiritual stillness with medicinal trees and eco-friendly infrastructure.
 
• The event saw over 50,000 attendees and millions joining virtually from 165 countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Babuji Vanam__

 __
 
• Babuji Vanam is a unique initiative that combines spirituality with environmental sustainability through the use of medicinal trees and eco-friendly designs.
 
 
 
• Kanha Shanti Vanam__
 
 
• Kanha Shanti Vanam is a spiritual and eco-friendly venue that serves as a center for meditation and environmental conservation.

questions.question: Where is Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki, the volcano that recently erupted, located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Indonesia.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki erupted on Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, releasing an ash cloud up to 0.7 miles into the atmosphere.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The volcano is located on Flores Island, a popular tourist destination in eastern Indonesia.**
 
• Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki emitted a thick ash cloud rising around 0.7 miles (1.2 km) high.
 
• The eruption occurred shortly after midnight, prompting immediate emergency response.
 
• Authorities raised the alert level to the highest tier due to the risk of further eruptions.
 
• Residents and visitors were advised to avoid the danger zone around the crater.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mount Lewotobi__

 __
 
• Comprises twin volcanoes: Lewotobi Laki-Laki (male) and Lewotobi Perempuan (female)
 
• Located in East Flores Regency, East Nusa Tenggara Province
 
 
 
• Flores Island__
 __
 
• Part of the Lesser Sunda Islands in eastern Indonesia
 
• Known for volcanic landscapes, beaches, and Komodo National Park
 
 
 
• Indonesia__
 __
 
• Home to over 130 active volcanoes, part of the Pacific “Ring of Fire”
 
• High risk of seismic and volcanic activity
 
 
 
• Volcanic Alert System (Indonesia)__
 
 
• Four-tier system: Normal, Advisory, Watch, Warning
 
• “Warning” level indicates eruption and immediate danger

questions.question: On which day is World Asthma Day observed each year?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**First Tuesday in May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Asthma Day: 6 May.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Asthma Day** is observed on the **first Tuesday of May** every year.

 
 
• 
 
The **first World Asthma Day** was held in **1998** during the **first World Asthma Meeting** in **Barcelona, Spain**.

 
 
• 
 
Celebrated in **over 35 countries** during its first year.

 
 
• 
 
The event is organized by the **Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA)**.

 
 
• 
 
**Theme for 2025**: **“Make Inhaled Treatments Accessible for ALL”**.

 
 
• 
 
The day aims to raise **awareness about asthma**, improve **access to treatment**, and promote **global efforts** to manage the condition.

questions.question: Who is the author of the book "Win The Battle of Your Mind: Scroll Less, Read More"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Reeta Ramamurthy Gupta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Reeta Ramamurthy Gupta’s book "Win The Battle of Your Mind: Scroll Less, Read More" was launched at Crossword Juhu, Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reeta Ramamurthy Gupta is the author of the book "Win The Battle of Your Mind: Scroll Less, Read More".**
 
• The book was launched at Crossword Juhu, Mumbai in the presence of eminent personalities.
 
• The book emphasizes cultivating mindfulness and building reading habits in the digital era.
 
• It serves as a practical guide for behavioral change and personal transformation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani__

 __
 
• Praised the book for its message promoting mindfulness and the value of reading in modern life.
 
 
 
• Behavioral Transformation__
 __
 
• The process of changing behavior patterns to achieve personal or professional goals.
 
 
 
• Mindfulness__
 __
 
• A mental state achieved by focusing awareness on the present moment, often used to reduce stress.
 
 
 
• Reading Habit__
 
 
• Regular practice of reading which enhances cognitive development and critical thinking skills.
